name: Pacific Lamprey Fund (Mitigation and Enhancement Fund)
summary: Hydro-licence mitigation fund for Pacific lamprey in the Lower Deschutes Basin, Oregon, paying for passage and barrier removal, in-stream habitat work, translocation and propagation. A separate research fund sits beside it.
reporting: Awardees submit annual progress reports on work completed, status of ongoing projects and expenditures.
